fetch_conference_yaml_files: fetch all conference YAML files from the ccfddl GitHub repository and parse them
parse_date_range: parse a date range string into start and end dates in YYYY-MM-DD format
transform_conference_data: transform ccfddl conference data format into a standardized conference dictionary format
update_conferences_main: run the main script to fetch new conferences and update the conferences YAML file
merge_conferences: merge new conference data with existing conferences while preserving custom fields and avoiding duplicates
